headline: GP Petroleums Limited: Press Release
sum: Press Release - GP Petroleums Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 01, 2026, titled "GP Petroleums Board approves strategic fundraise of upto Rs. 130 Crores via NCDs and OCDs to accelerate growth ".
